Sources: (U.S. Department of Energy 2024d; Joe Shangraw 2024d) 4.2.5 Upstream Inputs for Trackers Priority inputs for tracker production include torque tubes, fasteners/clamps, piles and rebar, racking rails, actuators, drive systems, dampers, and controllers (Table 12). The first four are detailed in Sections 4.3–4.6, and notes on the others are provided in Table 12 based on industry interviews in 2024 and 2025. Other upstream inputs are not discussed here due to limited supply chain information or relatively low importance, such as power supplies, sensors, and cables. Overall, industry stakeholders expressed confidence in tracker supply chains. They noted that trade policies pose supply chain risk but that this risk is mitigated via global diversification, domestic production, and in-house production. They also noted that advanced electronics in tracker controllers partially depend on China-related supply chains. 73 This report is available at no cost from the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) at www.nlr.gov/publications.
